content.short: Worldads is building a decentralized, blockchain-powered advertising network.
content.description:
WorldAds is transforming the fast growing digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising industry With innovative, blockchain-enabled smart screens / nodes mounted on vehicles.

The smart nodes deliver location-based, real-time ads in high-traffic urban areas, ensuring precision targeting and audience engagement.

By leveraging Cardano blockchain technology, WorldAds democratizes access into the ad economy through de-pin ownership while enhancing transparency, efficiency, and accountability, making it a game-changer for advertisers seeking impactful and measurable campaigns.
